AUTO_BUY_EXPLAIN: When a chosen supply drops below %d, %d more are bought with Coins at the shop price. A purchase waits until you have the Coins and a free supply slot. Prestige keeps these choices.
AUTO_BUY_EMPTY: Choose a supply to restock automatically
AUTO_BUY_UNLOCK_ORDER: Unlock the slot before it first
AUTO_BUY_SLOT_LOCKED: Unlock this Auto Buy slot first
AUTO_BUY_DUPLICATE: This supply already has an Auto Buy slot
